# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Add photographs of faults identified during tests performed with the Certinal Utility.
3. Add serial numbers for the devices under test (for which appliances are applicable).
4. Compile the PDF and send the file to the IT Administrator.
   
      
	
      
The detailed testing protocol document details the number and the name of each test done for each socket or appliance.  Should an appliance pass the test, only the results for each individual test are displayed. Should an appliance fail the test, all information listed above is displayed.<eos>
